name: olio.pb.style
label: Book Style
description: PictureBook V3 §4 book style: the one place a book's look is declared, replacing the book.sdConfig / book.compositeSdConfig / meta-note drift. Resolved per §4.1 as deployment defaults -> style (book.style -> style.parent chain -> series.style) -> composition override -> attempt override; no step writes to its parent. No field carries a schema default (PB2 convention rule 3, TestPbModelSchema): enum columns read NULL as UNKNOWN, booleans materialise false, ints 0 (= unset). 'parent' is a self reference with no $notInParent rule, so depth capping and self-parent rejection belong to the resolver and the write path (P2-3), and every read projects it through PbStyleUtil.styleRequest() rather than planMost.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The positive style text every compiler appends exactly once (§4).

fields.name: exclusions
fields.description: Negative prompt / exclusions, applied by every compiler including ChapBook (G-25).

fields.name: sdConfig
fields.description: Sampler/steps/cfg/LoRAs/hires: the existing canonical config record (KI-38).

fields.name: taskModels
fields.description: JSON object of model per task, keyed by §16's names: portrait, location, sceneDirect, inpaint, harmonize, upscale. Resolved by ModelResolver (P2-2); a missing task falls back to the style default and then to the deployment default.

fields.name: referenceImages
fields.description: Style anchors (an approved scene, artwork) for strategies that support style references. Participation-backed and never projected on a style read: read on demand through PbStyleUtil.listReferenceImages (identity, name, contentType - never the bytes) and written through PbStyleUtil.addReferenceImage as the requesting user.

fields.name: palette
fields.description: Free-text palette / lighting direction, compiled into the prompt.

fields.name: customWidth
fields.description: Meaningful only when pageFormat is CUSTOM. The DDL default 0 means unset.

fields.name: customHeight
fields.description: Meaningful only when pageFormat is CUSTOM. The DDL default 0 means unset.

fields.name: qualityPreset
fields.description: DRAFT, STANDARD or FINAL (§18); the values live in olio/illustration/qualityPresets.json. UNKNOWN/null means the resource's defaultPreset.

fields.name: photoreal
fields.description: Whether compilers may emit realism boilerplate. False for comic/anime/art (G-16).

fields.name: locked
fields.description: §4.1: when true, the style-field set is frozen. Enforced on the style write path (PUT /{book}/style refuses style-field edits to this style and to any style below it in the chain until unlocked; P2-3). Composition overrides (§4.1) are checked when compositions exist (Phase 4); node configOverride writes are not checked. This is only the flag.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: BOOK, SERIES or LIBRARY. A series style is inherited by its chapter books.

fields.name: parent
fields.description: The style this one inherits from (§4.1). Null for a root style.
